01 Project Overview

A decentralized, institutionalized peer-to-peer knowledge sharing and mentorship ecosystem.

Academic Context & Peer Pedagogy

In modern engineering education, students excel in distinct specialized skills (e.g., React, Tailwind CSS, System Design, Cloud Deployment) while simultaneously seeking guidance in other technical domains.

Conventional peer learning in universities relies on ad-hoc WhatsApp groups, leading to missed sessions, unorganized coordination, and lack of accountability.

Core Solution Capabilities
  • Synchronized Scheduling: Interactive calendar with duration picker (15–480 mins) and automated double-booking collision checks.
  • AI Compatibility Matcher: Integrates Google Gemini 1.5 Flash to compute 0–100% compatibility scores between learner goals and mentor skills.
  • Fair-Use Real-Time Chat: Full-duplex WebSocket messaging via Socket.io with typing indicators and unread indicators.
  • Secure Payment Verification: In-app Razorpay checkout in test mode with server-side HMAC-SHA256 signature verification.

02 Problem Statement & 03 Objectives

Addressing peer learning breakdowns through structured web engineering.

02 Operational Problem Statement

Existing informal tutoring mechanisms in colleges suffer from four critical breakdowns:

  • 1. Discovery Fragmentation: No central directory exists. Finding classmates proficient in Docker or Redis requires asking across disconnected social media channels.
  • 2. Scheduling Conflicts & Ghosting: Manual back-and-forth messaging causes latency. Without automated expiry timers, learners wait indefinitely without response.
  • 3. Financial Uncertainty & Disputes: Unprotected advance UPI transfers risk non-delivery if mentors fail to attend. Conversely, post-session models expose mentors to non-payment.
  • 4. Quality & Accountability Vacuum: Informal coordination provides no verified feedback, historical ratings, or administrative governance to penalize bad actors.
03 Project Engineering Objectives

The project achieves six primary functional objectives:

  • ✓ Mentor Listing & Hourly Pricing: Mentors configure profiles with skills, proficiency levels, and hourly rates in INR (or ₹0 volunteer).
  • ✓ Search & Interactive Booking: Learners search by skill tags and book flexible duration sessions (15–480 mins) with collision prevention.
  • ✓ Event-Driven Real-Time Chat: Sub-second bidirectional WebSocket text messaging restricted to active session participants.
  • ✓ Secure Role-Based Auth: Bcrypt password hashing (10 salt rounds) + dual-token JWT lifecycle (15m access + 7d HttpOnly refresh).
  • ✓ Tamper-Resistant Review System: 1-to-5 star ratings with compound unique indexes preventing duplicate submissions.
  • ✓ Responsive Academic UI: Single Page Application built with React 19 featuring dark/light theme toggle and mobile navigation.

05 System Architecture & Request Pipeline

3-Tier client-server topology augmented with real-time WebSockets and cloud connectors.

Architectural Layer Decomposition (Matching Reference Design)
LAYER ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES TECHNOLOGIES USED
Frontend Tier Single Page Application (SPA), state management, calendar interaction, responsive design, and WebSocket client React 19, Vite 8, React Router, Tailwind/CSS, Lucide React, Socket.io-client
Backend Tier REST API routing, authentication boundary, business rules, scheduling collision logic, and WebSocket room multiplexing Node.js v22 LTS, Express 5, Bcryptjs, JSON Web Tokens, Socket.io
AI Engine Semantic goal evaluation, multi-factor mentor ranking, and 0–100% compatibility score calculation Google Gemini 1.5 Flash API (SDK integration with fallback heuristic)
Database Tier Persistent document storage, compound index enforcement, relational references, and audit logging MongoDB Atlas (Cloud M0 Cluster), Mongoose ODM 9.9.1
6-Step Express Middleware Lifecycle

Every incoming HTTP request traverses a standardized security and parsing pipeline:

  • 1. compression(): Gzip response deflate reducing network payload overhead.
  • 2. express.json({ limit: '400kb' }): Body size ceiling defending against buffer overflow attacks.
  • 3. cookieParser(): Parses secure HttpOnly cookies for session refresh tokens.
  • 4. cors({ origin: CLIENT_URL, credentials: true }): Restricts cross-origin requests to whitelisted frontend.
  • 5. verifyToken & authorize('role'): Validates stateless JWTs and enforces RBAC route boundaries.
  • 6. Entity Ownership Check: Domain controllers confirm req.user.id owns the target record.

06 Module 1: Authentication & Bookings

User onboarding, credential security, interactive calendar scheduling, and Razorpay payments.

Functional Responsibilities
  • Bcrypt & JWT Security: Passwords encrypted with 10 salt rounds; 15-minute stateless access tokens + 7-day HttpOnly refresh cookies with rotation.
  • Role Onboarding: Seamless role selection during registration (Learner for skill acquisition, Mentor for instruction).
  • Collision Prevention: Database query checks overlapping intervals to eliminate double-booking for both participants.
  • 4-Hour Auto-Expiration Timer: Unattended requests expire automatically via actionExpiresAt timestamp, preventing deadlocks.
  • Slot Counter-Proposals: Mentors propose up to 3 alternate slots (suggestedSlots) on conflicting requests.
  • Razorpay Cryptographic Verification: Server creates order in paise and verifies HMAC-SHA256 signature before confirming.
  • Google Meet Link Injection: Stores verified Google Meet URLs for session delivery.

06 Module 2: Profile & Discovery Matcher

Custom technical profiles, hourly rate setup, faceted search, and Gemini AI matching.

Functional Responsibilities
  • Profile Customization: Users configure technical biographies, skills to teach/learn, proficiency tags, social links, and avatars.
  • Flexible Mentoring Rates: Mentors specify hourly fees in INR (₹0 volunteer supported) stored as integer paise to prevent rounding discrepancies.
  • Debounced Catalog Search: 300ms input debounce in /discover reduces server query load during real-time filtering.
  • Multi-Faceted Search Criteria: Filters mentors by keyword query, skill chips, hourly rate sliders, and minimum rating thresholds.
  • Google Gemini 1.5 Flash Matcher: Analyzes learner goals and budget constraints against the mentor database to compute 0–100% compatibility scores.
  • Public Mentor Profiles: Showcases verified ratings, reviews, completed sessions, and direct "Book Session" trigger.

06 Module 3: Real-Time Chat & Admin Governance

Socket.io persistent messaging, typing indicators, admin analytics, and audit logging.

Functional Responsibilities
  • Socket.io Messaging Bus: Full-duplex WebSocket messaging supporting join_room, send_message, typing, and message_read events.
  • Rich Messaging Controls: Live typing indicators ("User is typing..."), read receipts, chronological loading, and soft-deletion.
  • Anti-Spam Fair Use Guard: Caps unconfirmed bookings at 5 free messages to eliminate unsolicited marketing spam.
  • Admin Executive Dashboard: Real-time platform metrics: total users, active mentors, booking volume, and Gross Transaction Volume (GTV).
  • User Moderation & Account Suspension: Administrators toggle isSuspended status for policy violators.
  • Immutable Activity Logging: ActivityLog collection records administrative actions with timestamps and IP addresses.

06 Module 4: Ratings & Reviews Quality System

Verified post-session reviews, duplicate prevention, and mentor credibility scoring.

Functional Responsibilities
  • Quantitative 1-to-5 Star Ratings: Learners evaluate completed mentoring sessions on a 1–5 scale paired with descriptive written feedback.
  • Verified Sessions Only: Review submission is restricted to learners whose session status has transitioned to completed.
  • Anti-Fraud Duplicate Prevention: Compound unique index on { booking: 1, reviewer: 1 } guarantees exactly one review per booking.
  • Dynamic Credibility Recalculation: Mentor public profiles dynamically aggregate submitted reviews, recalculating average ratings.
  • Public Transparency: Displays ratings distribution and student reviews directly on public mentor portfolio cards.
  • Student Feedback Dialogue: Clean modal dialogue in MyBookings.jsx triggered upon session completion.

07 Database Design & Entity Invariants

10 Mongoose models persisted on MongoDB Atlas enforcing structural and business rules.

MODEL SCHEMA FIELDS & REFERENCES CRYPTOGRAPHIC & BUSINESS INVARIANTS
User name, email, password, role, skillsToTeach[], hourlyRate, availability[], isSuspended email unique; password length ≥ 6, Bcrypt salted (10 rounds); role enum strictly constrained.
Booking learner, mentor, date, time, duration, status, sessionFee, actionExpiresAt, meetingLink Compound index on (mentor, date, time) collision rejection; 4-hour countdown expiry.
Conversation participants[], participantKey, booking, lastMessage, lastActivityAt Unique participantKey (user1_user2) guarantees exactly one thread between two users.
Message conversation, sender, text, isRead, isEdited, isDeletedForEveryone Soft-delete preserving audit trails; compound index on (conversation, createdAt).
Review booking, reviewer, reviewee, rating, comment Compound unique index {booking: 1, reviewer: 1}; rating integer bounded between 1 and 5.
Wallet user, balance, currency, isActive user reference unique (1:1); monetary values stored in integer subunits (paise).
WalletTransaction wallet, user, booking, amount, type, reference, status Immutable insert-only ledger; type enum: credit, debit, payout, refund.
ActivityLog actor, action, entityType, entityId, metadata, ipAddress Chronological administrative audit trail for compliance and moderation tracking.
